questions.q: A runner increases the length of each run from 30 to 40 minutes. Which letter of FITT is being changed?
questions.why: Time is how long each session lasts.

questions.q: Which method of training is best for improving power?
questions.why: Explosive jumps such as depth jumps train power.

questions.q: What is the aerobic training zone for continuous training?
questions.why: Aerobic gains come from working at 60–80% of MHR.

questions.q: Explain what is meant by reversibility and why it matters to a performer.
questions.model: Reversibility means fitness gained through training is lost when training stops or reduces. It matters because a performer who takes a long break (e.g. through injury) will lose fitness, so must keep training regularly.
points: fitness/adaptations are lost when training stops or reduces
link to performer: must keep training / loses fitness after break
